Package edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo

Class TspDemoViewInfo

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.view.AbstractViewInfo
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspDemoViewInfo
public class TspDemoViewInfo extends AbstractViewInfo
Describes the TspDemoView for the in-app help / info dialog.

Returned by TspDemoView.getViewInfo() and displayed when the user clicks the info button in the view's title bar.
